# App Intents are not discoverable from a bare SwiftPM executable alone.
# Extract real compiler metadata into the bundle before signing; failure is fatal.
primary_architecture=${architectures%% *}
python3 "$script_directory/build-app-intents-metadata.py" \
    --source-root "$repository_root" --build-root "$build_root/swiftpm" \
    --output "$resources" --architecture "$primary_architecture" \
    --minimum-macos "$minimum_macos" \
    --evidence "$build_root/app-intents-metadata.json"
